Professional Summary
Data-focused analyst with experience building dashboards, automating analyses, and translating business requirements into actionable insights. Adept at using Power BI and Python-based data pipelines to support stakeholder decisions. Open to relocation anywhere in India.

Technical Skills
SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, pandas, Looker, Confluence, Agile

Work Experience

Data Analyst, GreenGrid (Dec 2024 - Present)
- Built and maintained weekly and monthly Power BI dashboards tracking energy usage and customer churn, enabling product and ops teams to reduce anomaly response time by 20% using Microsoft Excel-driven validation and Python data checks.
- Automated ETL pipelines with pandas and Python to ingest meter and billing data into centralized models, improving data refresh speed from 6 hours to under 90 minutes.
- Collaborated with stakeholders via Confluence and Agile ceremonies to define KPIs, and used Microsoft Excel for ad-hoc analysis to validate Power BI visualizations.

Business Analyst, Meesho (May 2024 - Nov 2024)
- Developed Power BI and Looker reports to monitor seller onboarding funnel and campaign ROI, highlighting segments that increased conversion by 12% through targeted interventions using Microsoft Excel and Python-supported cohort analyses.
- Performed SQL-based data extraction and pandas transformations to create reusable datasets for self-serve Tableau and Looker dashboards.
- Coordinated with product managers in Agile sprints and documented requirements and runbooks in Confluence for dashboard maintenance and handover.

Education
B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
